verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no S3-compatible endpoint, no cloud-storage sync, and no dedicated data-transfer tooling for Paperspace. What it does show is adjacent: shared drives within a private network, free unlimited bandwidth, SSH root access a user could use for their own copies, and a bare doc title about mounting datasets in Gradient Notebooks with no detail on sources or transfer mechanisms. None of these is the product's own documented capability for moving data in and out, and one community report says copying datasets into Core servers was very slow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling
